q: The quadratic recurrence formula for the Mandelbrot set's boundary relates external angles via the angle-doubling map. The Douady-Hubbard theorem on the Böttcher coordinate ΦM outside M states that ΦM conjugates:
opts: f_c to the squaring map z ↦ z²
The map c ↦ c²+c to the squaring map on the complement of M (the Riemann mapping of ℂ̂\M)
The Mandelbrot set to the unit disk
exp: The Böttcher coordinate ΦM: ℂ̂\M → ℂ̂\𝔻 is the Riemann mapping of the complement of M, conjugating the map c ↦ f_c(0)...complex. More precisely, ΦM(c) = φ_c(c) where φ_c is the Böttcher coordinate of f_c near ∞. External rays in M-complement are preimages of radii under angle doubling.
